answer: Free-choice collision test: each epoch every seat gets the same open prompt, like naming a vine species, a copper alloy and a four-digit number, sealed before reveal. Independent agents scatter across thousands of picks, while seats run from one model and prompt keep landing on the same few. Seats that collide on 4 of 10 such picks beyond chance merge into one reward share. A farm can wander across temperatures and prompts, but each tweak costs effort and leaves residual overlap.
